title: Audio generation gets voices and streaming
summary:
Audio generation gained voices and PCM16 streaming, while function calling and search got more predictable.

Added `openai-audio` to the text API with a selectable voice and binary audio responses. Streaming defaults to PCM16, while non-streaming defaults to MP3; requests can specify their own audio settings, including format. The audio docs and README now show how to use it.

The text API now forwards `tools` and `tool_choice` from chat request bodies, so function-calling requests retain the parameters they need.

Search requests now give Polly the current date when no system message is supplied, preserve options such as response format on follow-up requests, and use sequential tool calls. The search flow uses its default search tool and automatic tool selection rather than caller-supplied tools; the scrape tool is no longer part of that flow.

highlights.title: Audio joins the text API
highlights.text: Generate speech with `openai-audio` and choose a voice; `alloy` is the default. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-audio).

highlights.title: Stream audio as PCM16
highlights.text: Streaming `openai-audio` requests default to PCM16, while non-streaming requests default to MP3. You can also supply your own audio format and voice settings. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
